headline: A federal law names the Kingston, New York, post office at 90 Cornell Street after Staff Sergeant Robert H. Dietz.
what_it_does: This law officially designates the U.S. Postal Service facility at 90 Cornell Street in Kingston, New York, as the Staff Sergeant Robert H. Dietz Post Office Building. It changes only the official name of the building. It does not change postal services, rules, or staffing.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on November 5, 2015.
